title: Conformance claim and scope statement
description: Versioned statement of the standard and level claimed (WCAG 2.2 AA), the surfaces, roles, platforms and third-party components in scope, known exceptions, and the evaluation it rests on.

title: Accessibility Conformance Report (VPAT-based)
description: ACR in the current ITI VPAT INT edition (covering WCAG, Section 508 and EN 301 549) per product release, stating evaluation methods, product version, preparer and independence.
notes: CNV-EXP-001 AC-3 requires an ACR from automated plus manual assistive-technology testing before a surface is activated.

title: Automated accessibility test results in CI
description: Per-build results of automated WCAG A/AA rule checks (for example axe), layout reflow at 320 CSS px, 200 percent text and text-spacing sweeps, forced-colors and reduced-motion checks, with pass, fail and unknown counted separately.
producer: Forma ui-conformance CI job (forma@c8f40b4c, Chromium only, pilot) for design-system components; Unbound pipeline not yet assigned

title: Manual and assistive-technology test records
description: Per essential journey: keyboard-only walkthrough, screen-reader testing on named AT and browser pairs (for example NVDA with Firefox, JAWS with Chrome, VoiceOver on iOS and macOS, TalkBack on Android), moderated sessions with disabled participants, defects and retests.

title: Accessibility defect register and remediation metrics
description: All reported and found accessibility defects with WCAG criterion, severity, affected journeys, workaround offered, target and actual fix dates, and aging.

title: Accessible document validation results
description: For each issued document type: PDF/UA-1 validation output (for example veraPDF), Matterhorn manual checkpoint review, and confirmation that an accessible HTML rendition with the same snapshot identifier exists.

title: Brand compilation contrast gate output
description: Compiler result for each sponsor brand naming any failing color pair and confirming all shipped themes meet contrast thresholds.
producer: Forma brand compiler (forma@c8f40b4c) for Forma themes; Unbound sponsor brand compilation not yet built

title: Accessibility legal applicability assessment
description: Counsel-reviewed assessment of which accessibility laws apply to Echelon and to each customer segment (ADA Titles II and III, Section 508, state laws, European Accessibility Act) and the resulting contractual commitments.

title: Accessible support and authentication path record
description: Inventory of support channels and identity-verification methods with their accessibility features (relay calls, captioned video, non-cognitive authentication alternatives, adjustable timeouts) and test results.
